findings.property: out-of-bounds read of name when name_len exceeds the readable name buffer (for example SIZE_MAX)
findings.severity: high if real: read past a borrowed caller buffer
findings.rationale: A caller can pass a name_len larger than the readable name bytes; the UTF-8 scan would then read past the buffer.
findings.reproducer: tests/project/test_greeting.c: expect(max, SIZE_MAX, 128U, GREETING_NAME_TOO_LONG, "") and expect(max, GREETING_NAME_MAX + 1U, ...)

history.reason: Not a defect: validate() rejects name_len > GREETING_NAME_MAX at src/greeting.c:101 before check_name() reads any byte; the SIZE_MAX and 65-byte boundary tests cover it and the fuzz target checks it for every input length.
